sheets.title: ujust commands
sheets.subtitle: Bazzite's shortcut for common maintenance & fixes
sheets.intro: ujust is a Bazzite tool that turns common maintenance and troubleshooting tasks into short, memorable commands, typed into a terminal as the word ujust followed by the command name. Typing ujust by itself, with nothing after it, lists every command available, and a graphical app called Bazzite Portal offers many of the same commands as clickable buttons for anyone who'd rather avoid the terminal entirely.

commands.name: update
commands.desc: Updates the system, all Flatpak apps, and any containers, all in one go, instead of updating each separately.

commands.name: device-info
commands.desc: Gathers useful information about your system into a shareable link, handy when asking for help somewhere.

commands.name: logs-this-boot
commands.desc: Shows all system messages from the current session, useful for tracking down what went wrong after something misbehaves.

commands.name: fix-reset-steam
commands.desc: Resets Steam back to a fresh state without touching your games, saves, or library, useful if Steam itself is acting up.

commands.name: fix-proton-hang
commands.desc: Force-closes any stuck Proton or Wine processes, useful when a game fails to close properly and won't let you relaunch it.

commands.name: restart-pipewire
commands.desc: Restarts the audio system, a quick fix for crackling or broken sound.

commands.name: clean-system
commands.desc: Clears out old, unused container images, Flatpak leftovers, and update data to free up disk space.

commands.name: enroll-secure-boot-key
commands.desc: Registers the driver signing key needed to use Secure Boot with an Nvidia graphics card.

commands.name: bios
commands.desc: Reboots the computer straight into its BIOS or UEFI firmware screen, skipping the usual boot process.

commands.name: regenerate-grub
commands.desc: Rebuilds the boot menu so Windows shows up properly alongside Bazzite, useful after installing Windows on a dual-boot setup.

commands.name: setup-boot-windows-steam
commands.desc: Adds a shortcut inside Steam that reboots straight into Windows, a convenience for dual-boot setups.

commands.name: enable-tailscale
commands.desc: Turns on support for Tailscale, the private networking tool.

commands.name: setup-decky
commands.desc: Installs and configures Decky Loader, a plugin system for Steam's Gaming Mode.

commands.name: bazzite-cli
commands.desc: Adds a more informative, nicer-looking terminal prompt style.

commands.name: ujust --choose
commands.desc: Not a single task, this opens an interactive menu of every available command, worth remembering on its own if none of the specific names above stick.

sheets.outro: Run any of these by typing ujust followed by the command name, for example ujust update.

sheets.title: Keyboard shortcuts
sheets.subtitle: KDE Plasma defaults — Bazzite's desktop edition
sheets.intro: These are the default KDE Plasma shortcuts, since that's the desktop environment Bazzite's desktop edition uses, and every one of them can be changed under System Settings, Shortcuts. Meta refers to the key with the Windows-style logo on most keyboards.

sheets.note: Text and document shortcuts are standard across nearly every application, not just KDE's own. File shortcuts apply mainly inside Dolphin and file dialogs.
sheets.outro: The full list, and the ability to customize any of these, lives under System Settings, Shortcuts, Global Shortcuts.
